citations.assessment: The primary witness explicitly names Levi bar Ḥayta for the farewell idiom.
The exact chain includes Yehoshua bar Neḥemyah, Levi bar Ḥayta and R. Abba in the name of Ḥiyya bar Abba. The root condenses the list because Levi is the lemma.
This passage explicitly gives R. Abba son of R. Ḥiyya bar Abba. The separate Behar report’s wording still stands as a witness.
The exact parallel reads Ḥavit in the digital text, close to Heilprin’s reported Havit. Keep his assertion of scribal error separate from the evidence.
The exact discussion names Levi bar Ḥayta, R. Yose and R. Berekhya in the episode about the language of the Shema.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
